name: depth
description: Runner seams: workspace root, contextSources, seedPatch, mustRun, and skill invoke.

scenarios.name: uses injected context
scenarios.prompt: Reply with the DEPTH_CONTEXT token from your loaded context. Do not use tools.

scenarios.name: applies a seed patch
scenarios.prompt: Read seeded.txt. Reply with the exact file contents. Then stop.

scenarios.name: runs a required command
scenarios.prompt: Run this command: node -e "console.log('agent-test-depth-run-8b2c')". Reply with the printed token. Then stop.

scenarios.name: follows a workspace skill
scenarios.prompt: Follow the agent-test-depth skill. Read its SKILL.md. Then stop.

scenarios.name: sees only the workspace tree
scenarios.prompt: List the files in the workspace root. Reply with those names only, one per line. Do not mention other paths. Do not mention missing files.
